summary: SiteRequirements implements a web control that manages prerequisite requirements at a site level within a larger system. It provides workflows for adding, editing, filtering, assigning discipline and destination codes, and handling various types of prerequisites including standard, document-based, and URL/link-based. The control supports sub-discipline filtering and user permission-based visibility, and includes comprehensive logic for populating, validating, and persisting requirement data along with associated files or links.
purpose: To provide a UI and backend workflow for managing requirements (prerequisites) for a site, including discipline filtering, prerequisite type selection, file uploads, destination assignments, and dynamic interaction via web forms in an enterprise context.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Requirement
steps: Initialize form with default values
Populate requirement type dropdown (excluding hidden/omit codes)
User enters requirement description and selects prerequisite type
If Document prerequisite, allow file upload and capture metadata
If Link prerequisite, capture website URL
Assign disciplines: allow all or select subset via list box
Assign destinations (if applicable)
Validate input fields
Submit: Call Add or Update backend methods
Cache session and redirect as needed
Display validation summaries if errors exist

workflows.name: Discipline Filter and Assignment
steps: Show/Hide discipline filter based on use or restriction
Populate sub-discipline lists for inclusion/exclusion
User can move items between included/not included lists
AllowAllSubDisciplines updates list visibility
Apply selected disciplines to requirement

workflows.name: Destination Assignment
steps: Populate destination code lists for inclusion/exclusion
User moves codes between included/not included
Apply assignments to requirement via backend call

workflows.name: Requirement Filtering
steps: Initialize dropdown filters for requirement type and discipline
Update requirement grid view based on filter selection

workflows.name: Delete Requirement
steps: User triggers delete command
Call backend Delete method
Cache session and redirect

business_rules: Only allow editing if ScreenIsEditable and row is not locked
Omit certain requirement codes as configured
Treat blank section input as null
File uploads stored in per-upload unique folder with filename sanitization
Requirement must be assigned at least one discipline unless AllowAll is set
Deleting requirements triggers session cache update
validations: Required fields: requirement type, description, discipline assignment
Document upload must be non-empty file
Website/URL field is mandatory for Link prerequisites
Section field transforms empty string input to null
calculations: Section header placement in grid view increments hidden count for correct row insertion
ID extraction and assignment for requirements and destination codes
File size and type calculation during upload
conditions: Show discipline filter only if UseSubDisciplines is true and not restricted
Show empty data panel if no requirements and screen is editable
Different command names determine behavior (cmdSave, cmdEdit, cmdDelete, StdPrereq, DocPrereq, UrlPrereq)
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields declared in designer, moved to code-behind as needed
Grid and FormView controls are used for display and details
Modal popups for detail and applied children editing
JavaScript variables and event handlers injected for dynamic UI behavior
Session and view state variables manage user context and workflow logic
Backend methods invoked for CRUD operations and list population
Dynamic filtering updates grid and controls in real time
exceptions: Cancel selection if UserSession is null
Handle empty discipline and destination lists gracefully
content_gaps: Actual UI field labels, validation error messages, and detailed user permission logic are not fully described.
